full_judgment: 8. Mr. Sk. Razzaque Ali, the learned Advocate for the appellants lastly submits that the sale could not be easily set aside and in support of his, contention he has relied upon a decision reported in 12 D.L.R. page 215 in the case of Abdul Ali Mridha V. Surat Ali Molla & others wherein it was held a "a sale can be set s aside in part. It cannot be laid down as a general proposition of law that when a sale is set aside on the around of a material irregularity or fraud in publishing or conducting sale, the same should be set aside in its entirety, even though the application for setting aside is made by only one of the interested parties irrespective of other circumstances of the case, while generally speaking such should be the case, the facts of each case will determine whether this proposition should be modified in view of other circumstances, such as the question of limitation, res judicata, etc. in respect of the claim of the other interested parties."
